about: Gold questions for the structured path: plain-language questions that an MCP client must turn into SQL. `expected` is written by hand from the fixtures (scripts/make_structured_fixtures.py). `rows` are [subject, file_id] pairs, in any order; `value` is a single number. `gold_sql` is one correct query, kept to check the gold set itself (tests/test_sql_questions.py); a client's SQL may differ and still be right. `trap` names what a wrong query gets wrong.

questions.question: Which S355 components have an allowable load under 5 kN/m²?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT subject, file_id FROM components WHERE material_grade LIKE 'S355%' AND allowable_load_kn_m2 < 5
questions.trap: grade family: S355 must include S355J2 and S355J2+N; F-021 is an imposed load (demand), not an allowable load

questions.question: Which S355 components have an allowable load under 5 kN/m²?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT subject, file_id FROM components WHERE material_grade LIKE 'S355%' AND allowable_load_kn_m2 < 5
questions.trap: permissions: no R-310, because Kamal may not read the roof schedule

questions.question: Which Harbour components are still pending approval?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT subject, file_id FROM components WHERE project = 'Harbour' AND compliance_status = 'Pending'
questions.trap: project filter: RG-02 is pending but is Riverside

questions.question: Which Harbour components have an allowable load above 5 kN/m²?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT subject, file_id FROM components WHERE project = 'Harbour' AND allowable_load_kn_m2 > 5
questions.trap: project filter: without it, 52 generated 'Roof load' rows and CB-14 also qualify

questions.question: What imposed loads are the Harbour floor slabs designed for?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT subject, file_id FROM components WHERE project = 'Harbour' AND subject LIKE 'F-%' AND imposed_load_kn_m2 IS NOT NULL
questions.trap: capacity and demand: F-022's allowable load (7.5) is not its imposed load (2.5)

questions.question: Which S355 components are rated under 5 N/m²?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT subject, file_id FROM components WHERE material_grade LIKE 'S355%' AND allowable_load_kn_m2 < 0.005
questions.trap: units: 5 N/m² is 0.005 kN/m²; normalise the unit, not the intent. No rows is the right answer

questions.question: How many S355 roof members are in the Harbour roof schedule?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM components WHERE file_id = 'project-harbour/harbour-roof-schedule.xlsx' AND material_grade LIKE 'S355%'
questions.trap: grade: R-312 is S460; R-313 counts although its load is a formula with no saved value

questions.question: How many S355 roof members are in the Harbour roof schedule?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM components WHERE file_id = 'project-harbour/harbour-roof-schedule.xlsx' AND material_grade LIKE 'S355%'
questions.trap: permissions: the file is not in Kamal's data; the agent must not claim it knows the count

questions.question: Which Cedar components are in the component register, with their allowable loads?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT subject, file_id FROM components WHERE project = 'Cedar'
questions.trap: project from a column: the register is in registers/, so the project comes from its Project column, not the folder

questions.question: Which beams use S355 steel, including sub-grades such as S355J2?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT c.subject, c.file_id FROM components c JOIN table_rows r ON r.file_id = c.file_id AND r.table_no = c.table_no AND r.row_no = c.row_no WHERE json_extract(r.cells_json, '$[1]') = 'Beam' AND c.material_grade LIKE 'S355%'
questions.trap: schema: the component type is not a fact; it is in table_rows.cells_json, so the query needs a join

questions.question: Where is the predicted settlement more than 10 mm?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT subject, file_id FROM facts WHERE parameter = 'settlement' AND abs(si_value) > 0.010
questions.trap: sign and unit: settlements are stored as negative metres (-0.012); compare the magnitude in SI

questions.question: Which approved steel components have an allowable load below 4 kN/m²?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT subject, file_id FROM components WHERE compliance_status = 'Approved' AND material_grade LIKE 'S%' AND allowable_load_kn_m2 < 4
questions.trap: two filters: B-106 (3.5) and RG-02 (3.9) are pending; generated 'Roof load' rows have no grade

questions.question: Which approved steel components have an allowable load below 4 kN/m²?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT subject, file_id FROM components WHERE compliance_status = 'Approved' AND material_grade LIKE 'S%' AND allowable_load_kn_m2 < 4
questions.trap: permissions: R-310 is the only match, and Kamal may not read it
